text: You're looking for a dish that's high in fiber and can be prepared within 60 minutes. This Sopa De Frijoles Con Huevos recipe fits your requirements perfectly. The combination of pinto beans, cooked white rice, and vegetables like green bell pepper and onion provides a good amount of fiber, helping you meet your health goal. As a vegetarian, you'll appreciate the absence of meat, and the recipe is also dairy-free, aligning with your dietary constraints. The cooking time is relatively short, making it an ideal choice for a quick and nutritious meal.
